column1: # The project this engine's committed answers come from. BigQuery is a Google
# Cloud service: there is no image and no container.
# default judges bigquery/parser/testdata/compat.tsv through live BigQuery
# dry-run (no dataset is created or mutated): image names the project and job
# location ("gcp:bigquery:<project>:<location>"), digest is the SHA-256 of that
# string confirmed by a live `SELECT 1` dry-run job, and the source tag is the
# day the answers were recorded.
# driver records bigquery/driver's tapes against a scratch dataset: image names
# the project and the dataset's location, digest is the SHA-256 of what
# `datasets.get` states as `<id> <location> <creationTime>`, and the source tag
# is the day the answers were recorded. A dataset recreated anywhere else
# answers another creationTime, so its digest moves and the pin fails instead of
# quietly replaying. The service account is never part of a pin.
# span records bigquery/analysis's span.tsv: dry-run queries on a dataset the
# recording builds and deletes (omni_span), so the pin is the project and
# location alone, confirmed as default's is.
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag
